sentences.en: I tied a stick to the plant to straighten it.
sentences.zh: 我把一根棍子绑在植物上，让它变直。

sentences.en: It'll take about a week to straighten out my affairs.
sentences.zh: 整理好我的事务大约需要一周时间。

sentences.en: The picture is hanging crooked. Could you please straighten it?
sentences.zh: 这幅画挂得歪了。你能把它扶正一下吗？

senses.zh: 变直，把…弄直,整理，整顿,使…改正,使…好转vi.变好起来
